entities.summary: Bishop Hryhoriy Komar is a Ukrainian Greek Catholic hierarch, who is currently serving as the Titular Bishop of Acci and Apostolic Administrator of the Ukrainian Catholic Apostolic Exarchate of Italy. Previously he served as an Auxiliary bishop of Sambir – Drohobych.
